injuries.name: Jalen Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Keshon Gilbert
injuries.detail: Gilbert is out for Friday's game against the Wizards due to left knee inflammation.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.detail: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.detail: Newell (toe) is out for Friday's game against Washington.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Egor Demin
injuries.detail: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

injuries.name: Day'Ron Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe registered 15 points (5-7 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 13 rebounds and four assists across 26 minutes in Sunday's 98-90 win over the Pacers.

injuries.name: Noah Clowney
injuries.detail: Clowney is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Hawks due to an illness.

injuries.name: Tyler Bilodeau
injuries.detail: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Jarrett Allen
injuries.detail: Allen (knee) is out for Friday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Sam Merrill
injuries.detail: Merrill (elbow) won't return to Friday's game against the 76ers, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Jaylon Tyson
injuries.detail: Tyson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: DeMar DeRozan
injuries.detail: DeRozan (back) is probable for Saturday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Draymond Green
injuries.detail: Green (elbow) is listed as questionable ahead of Saturday's game against Orlando.

injuries.name: Gui Santos
injuries.detail: Santos (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game versus Orlando, per Nick Friedell of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Gary Payton II
injuries.detail: Payton is questionable to play Saturday against the Magic due to right calf tightness.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

injuries.name: Clint Capela
injuries.detail: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
injuries.detail: Oubre (calf) is questionable for Saturday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is questionable for Saturday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: Josh Hart
injuries.detail: Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMaho

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.detail: Topic (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.detail: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Goodwin
injuries.detail: Goodwin (calf) is doubtful for Saturday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Rasheer Fleming
injuries.detail: Fleming (ankle) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.detail: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Davis
injuries.detail: Davis (ankle) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.
